note: OTHMODE Open Source Registry — Search First evidence. Git-curated (one writer: repository review), read by /api/othmode/oss-registry. Every field below was live-verified on the recorded date or is explicitly TO-VERIFY; nothing is invented. REJECTED records are kept so dead ends are never re-evaluated. License must be verified before a record may become INTEGRATED.

records.othmode_usage: Search First policy + Selector evidence input

records.name: Graphify
records.license: Apache-2.0 (License-Expression verified from the installed package metadata)
records.purpose: Turns codebases/docs into local queryable knowledge graphs for AI assistants (deterministic AST parsing, ~40 languages, no LLM calls for code).
records.integration_method: installed on the production VPS as the deploy user in an isolated venv (~/.local/share/graphify-venv, symlinked to ~/.local/bin/graphify); vendor Claude skill registered at ~/.claude/skills/graphify via `graphify install --platform claude`; first real graph built from projects/command-center (299 nodes / 818 edges, deterministic AST only, no LLM, no API key) at ~/oth-graphs/graphify-out/graph.json and queried via `graphify explain`. OTHMODE runtime has zero dependency on it (graceful absence); generated graphify-out/ is gitignored.
records.security: runs locally in a per-user venv; deterministic AST extraction used exclusively (no network, no API keys read); semantic extraction not enabled; graph outputs stored outside Git
records.othmode_usage: code/project/knowledge/evolution relationship graphs — vendor skill (implementation) + repo skill `graphify` (policy/boundary); recorded in Health as an optional capability
records.name_collision_note: the vendor skill and the repo policy skill share the name `graphify` by design: the repo skill (project scope) carries only the OTHMODE boundary rules and defers execution to the vendor skill (user scope) — resolved as MERGE in docs/SKILLS_EVOLUTION.md

records.name: Evolver Claude Code Plugin
records.license: MIT (plugin hooks/skills/commands; the optional engine is separate — see @evomap/evolver)
records.purpose: Claude Code plugin for GEP evolution memory: session hooks, capability-evolver skill, evolution commands, MCP bridge.
records.integration_method: pattern-reference: OTHMODE's evolution recording (signals at work time, outcomes at result time, memory recall before work) follows its hook pattern; the plugin itself is NOT installed because its memory model would be a second evolution store and its MCP bridge points at EvoMap infrastructure, which OTHMODE excludes.

records.name: @evomap/evolver (GEP engine)
records.license: GPL-3.0-or-later on 1.x releases; the 2.0.23 registry metadata carries no license field — treated as GPL-family / TO-VERIFY
records.purpose: The full GEP evolution engine (genes, capsules, events, selector, EvoMap network client).
records.integration_method: NOT vendored, NOT installed. GEP data-model concepts (gene/capsule/event shapes, selector decisions) are adopted as format compatibility in projects/othmode/evolution/; no GPL code enters this repository.
records.rejection_reason: GPL-3.0-or-later engine code is license-incompatible with embedding into this repository's components, and the engine's EvoMap network features are explicitly out of the OTHMODE boundary. Concepts adopted; code excluded.

records.name: Session Handoff pattern
records.purpose: Session continuity: durable handover entries, state surfacing at session start, doc sync at stage completion.
